goals.instruction: Glitch has been after Rogue's data shard all night. Get it into his hands.
Glitch's rig is running on fumes. Make sure he walks away with Mux's charge cell.
Rogue's hands are shaking. I want her holding that stimpak by the end of this.
The data shard belongs in the back room with Mux. See that he gets it.
Glitch needs to get out of sight for a while. Put him in the back room.
Mux has been hiding among his crates long enough. Bring him out to the bar.
Rogue wants to see what Mux has stacked up in the back. Get her back there.
Have Rogue shout out to the whole bar that it's last orders.
Rogue should tell Glitch straight to his face, loud enough that nobody could miss it, that his welcome is wearing thin.
Glitch should lean in close and tell Rogue, for her ears only, that he'll be gone before sunrise.
I'd like Mux to ask Glitch, out loud and to him directly, whether the last cell held up.
Have Glitch jack into the data shard and read out the contacts stored on it.
Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.
